title: Outworlders at the Stake
front_description: In the execution arena, Padmé and Anakin are dragged to upright posts and chained to them, alongside fellow prisoner Obi-Wan Kenobi. "I was beginning to wonder if you´d gotten my message," the older Jedi says dryly. "I retransmitted it as you requested, Master," Anakin replies. "Then," he adds, somewhat sheepishly, "we decided to come and rescue you ourselves." Obi-Wan can´t resist an ironic quip: "Good job!"
back_description: Edwin Natividad's design of the arena vehicle containing Anakin and Padmé.
